newsitem.title: UK: MAM considering share buyback - report.
newsitem.headline: MAM considering share buyback - report.

text.p: One of Britain's leading fund managers, Mercury Asset Management Plc, is considering returning approximately 100 million stg to shareholders through a share buy-back or an improved dividend, the Financial Times said on Tuesday.
This follows the sale on Monday of its Swiss private banking unit Mercury Bank AG to Luxembourg-based Safra Republic Holdings SA for about 250 million Swiss francs cash.

The Mercury Bank deal takes MAM's cash pile to about 250 million stg, the FT said. Analysts said they expected MAM to make a decision early next year on any share buy-back once it has studied the implications of new UK tax rules.
